title: VTA PCS — Applications — Create — payload
description: An applicant's client asks its VTA to start a hidden-vetting application: the VTA derives a fresh PCS key for it, keeps the key, and returns the PCS identifier vetters attest to.

contextId.description: The context the engine belongs to. Its key is derived from this context's base.

community.description: The community's DID: the helper whose parameters the engine runs under.

joinDid.description: The DID the applicant joins the community as. Bound into the proof, so the proof cannot be carried to another join.

parameters.description: The community's published hidden-vetting parameters, copied verbatim from its join manifest.

Response.title: VTA PCS — Applications — Create — response payload
